result.description: Compact desktop audio speaker designed for ambient playback, conference rooms, and low-profile home setups. Features a single full-range driver, USB-C power input, Bluetooth audio pairing, and a soft-touch enclosure with an integrated status light. Tuned for clear midrange speech and moderate-volume music, with a focus on easy placement rather than deep bass output.
result.title: Noctil N-14 aurora desk speaker
